notes.title: Zardy's Maze 3.01 Bug Fixes + Zardy's Maze 2 Wishlist
notes.notes:
Hello corn maze enthusiasts! We recently pushed out a fix to resolve the missing corn in the game. Alongside this we fixed a UI issue that made the high score for challenge 10 display over the custom challenge menu which was not intended.

3.01:
Missing cornfield fixed.
High score UI issue resolved.

Also, in case you haven't done so yet, you can now wishlist Zardy's Maze 2 on steam!

notes.title: Zardy's Maze 3.0 Update
notes.notes:
Major Changes

 Added new 3 challenges to the game: 8, 9, and 10.

Minor Changes

 Options menu sprint toggle button
 Options menu resolution settings

Quality of Life / Bug Fixes

 Pumpkin Crawlers no longer slow you down in corn.
 Collision bug fixed that allowed players to climb into sky.
 Game brightness slightly increased.
 Pumpkin Jack footstep audio distance increased.
 Pumpkin Jack footstep sounds altered.
 Drought fog distance reduced.
 Zardy’s Maze 2 wishlist added to title screen.
 Full credits added to title screen.

notes.title: Zardy's Maze 2 is in Development! (And a ZM 1 Content Update is Coming Soon!)
notes.notes:
Hello fellow corn maze fans! It's been a while!

For those who missed the initial announcement, Zardy's Maze 2 is in development! Check out the teaser trailer if you haven't!

[previewyoutube=EVQhA6yVT_U;full][/previewyoutube]

With the announcement of Zardy's Maze 2, Cablecrow plushies are available for a limited time! All sales go towards developing the upcoming game. You can even toss in a few extra bucks to get your name in the credits! Your Makeship account name will be the name that is utilized if that option is chosen!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544506/23221ad7d88d545a0053aae40d1f4633bd46de3f.jpg
If you want to snag one yourself, go here! ► https://shop.makeship.com/3ISHrHz

But we aren't done with Zardy's Maze 1 yet! Since it will still be a while before we have any more Zardy's Maze 2 information to share, we plan on releasing a free Zardy's Maze 1 update soon to hold you over! We ran into a few hiccups but the plan is to have it come out within a few weeks. You can expect 3 new challenges to tackle and we're really looking forward to seeing you overcome them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544506/f63be4008c7c41fef21724657694b29276811ea6.png

notes.title: The Zardy's Maze Documentary is released! (New FNF Mod + Plushie + ZM Update!)
notes.notes:
Hello maze enthusiasts!

It's been a while! But I'm here to bring some neat news! First off, Zardy's Maze will be receiving an update sometime in the future! Challenge 7 wasn't the end game... And there's a greater challenge brewing in the dark. We're excited to show you what we've been working on, so stay tuned! With that said, there's a new Zardy's Maze documentary out about how we made the entire game. You can find it here on YouTube!

[previewyoutube=mlufZP4YzgA;full][/previewyoutube]

----

Second, we now have an official Zardy plush for sale for a limited time! Based off his Zardy's Maze appearance, this cute lil' fella stares at you with doom-filled eyes while also looking absolutely adorable. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39544506/86c66f97be8bcc167cc038fec3178d43e9bfa0e2.jpg

All proceeds help the game, mods, and future community projects!

notes.title: Steam Achievement Fixes (Version 2.04)
notes.notes: In version 2.03 we ran into an issue where Steam Achievements would not trigger on MacOS for certain players. With 2.04 we've resolved that issue and Steam Achievements should now unlock for both PC and Mac! Happy hunting!

notes.title: Version 2.03 Release! Steam Achievements are here!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We just pushed an update for Zardy's Maze 2.03! In this update we added Steam Achievements for all you maze enthusiasts! Can you collect them all? Happy hunting!

Note: Some users have reported problems with Achievements unlocking. We're trying to resolve this as soon as possible!

notes.title: Version 2.02 Release!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We just pushed an update for Zardy's Maze 2.02! In this update we made a few changes:

1. Added additional sound effects to communicate gameplay events better.

2. Updated the visuals of the enemy Cornstalker to make them easier to see.

3. Revised the How to Play screen with more information.

4. Fixed an error with the vine count prompt sometimes not appearing before entering the maze.

Currently we are aware that on rare occasions players can fall through the ground when restarting a game. We're actively trying to figure out what is causing this issue, but we appreciate people pointing it out! If this happens to you, pause and restart the game. Please feel free to create a discussion post on Steam if you run into a bug. Any and all information is super appreciative and helpful! In other news, we are also working on Steam achievements too - so stay tuned!

Enjoy your time in the maze!
